newsitem.title: USA: Ultramar seen shutting coker at Calif. plant.
newsitem.headline: Ultramar seen shutting coker at Calif. plant.

text.p: Ultramar Corp shut a 12,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) coker at its Los Angeles-area refinery over the weekend for a week of maintenance originally planned for late this year, an industry source said.
"It'll be down all week," said a source familiar the plant's operations.
The plant, in Wilmington, Calif., produces 100,000 bpd of refined products.
Crude oil runs had "definitely" been cut, the source said, but did not immediately know the overall effect on crude or products production.
The company was not immediately available for comment.
Refinery margins have fallen about 21 percent early in the fourth quarter, prompting widespread speculation among traders that refineries would trim runs.
Early last week, Ultramar said it planned to shut several hydroprocessors at the Wilmington facility by week's end.
